They score the summaries on a 5-point Likert scale (1 = Not at all, 5 = Very much so) across four criteria: • Key Events: Are the key events included? • Flow: Is the contextual information demonstrated specifically? • Factuality: Does the summary have high factual accuracy? • Readability: Does the summary have high readability?
